reason: I would try the free plan at most, and 50 conversations with a badge is enough to test it. I would not pay inside a month without reviews on G2 or Capterra and proof that visitors use it instead of ignoring it.
objection: Another monthly subscription for something visitors might ignore. No proof it lifts conversions, and a cute mascot on a kids app could feel gimmicky or raise safety and data questions.
would_change_my_mind: Independent G2/Capterra reviews plus a case study showing a measurable lift in activation or conversion, and a clear answer on child data safety, with the free plan hitting its limit because it is actually being used.
